description: Every Seats.aero Partner API endpoint, plus a local award-availability store that tells you what is new, what is still live, and where your miles reach nonstop.

novel_features.name: New-since award watch
novel_features.description: See which award seats appeared on a route since you last looked, from your synced local data.

novel_features.name: Credit-aware recheck
novel_features.description: Re-verify aging award rows are still live right before booking. It performs one live quota probe per run (1 daily call), and --apply is refused when quota is unknown unless --ignore-quota is passed.

novel_features.name: Cross-program direct-only scan
novel_features.description: Find direct-flight award seats under a mileage ceiling across every synced program at once.

novel_features.name: Cabin/date calendar matrix
novel_features.description: Turn one route's synced availability into a date-by-cabin matrix you can scan at a glance.

novel_features.name: Nonstop reach finder
novel_features.description: Discover where your miles can take you nonstop from one airport, ranked by cost and cross-checked against real dated seats.
